protocol.construction: balanced-diverse starts from the same balanced seed, fixed10,000 quota-preserving swaps; no winning results
protocol.historical: Reconstructed validation only, not recorded bets; no historical or synthetic holdout evaluated
protocol.criterion: Exploratory advancement only: mean7+ advantage>=1percentage point versus balanced AND V13.3; Bonferroni3-comparison bootstrap lower bounds>0 versus all3 references; all leave-one-out means>0; mean8+ deterioration versus V13.3 no worse than0.2percentage point
protocol.uncertainty: 10,000 bootstrap resamples of whole independent seed replicates; 3 Bonferroni-adjusted percentile intervals, approximate with few replicates; not confirmatory proof
protocol.activation: None. No automatic deployment or holdout consumption
